mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties that combine additively, and tolterodine inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes nortriptyline, potentially increasing nortriptyline levels.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia, confusion); consider dose reduction of nortriptyline if tolterodine is initiated; obtain baseline ECG and monitor QTc interval.
